sentences.en: The reformers were subject to every attack from the Establishment.
sentences.zh: 改革者遭到了守旧势力的种种攻击。

sentences.en: This establishment attracts a clientele of both tourists and businessmen.
sentences.zh: 这家企业吸引了来自游客和商人的客户群。

sentences.en: He represents the establishment, while she sympathizes with the reformers.
sentences.zh: 他代表保守派，而她则同情改革者。

phrases.zh: 政治体制：指反对变革的政治权力结构或当权集团
